epsilon_branch.caveat: association, not causal: depth and volume are jointly determined

k_arb.caveat: k_arb is measured against the pool's own future mid, and σ comes from the same pool-price series. It is the fraction of pool-price variance LPs trade through at a loss, not the fraction of external (CEX) LVR realised. It understates external LVR wherever the pool price lags the reference market, which is most likely on stale long-tail books. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md D0.6(4).
k_arb.decline_rule: POST-HOC (chosen after seeing ratios like 327 and -465 on pools with < $300 of 90-day LVR): a pool's k_arb is declined when its standard error, sd(daily markout)·sqrt(days)/LVR, exceeds 0.5. A declined pool has no k_arb and falls back to the class prior. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md D0.7.

vol_depth.thresholds_note: Decile cut, 24 h baseline, 95% recovery level, 24 h trough window, 72 h horizon and the calm-hour placebo (|r| <= pool median) were chosen for this analysis, not pre-registered.
